title: Why Your Saskatoon Winter Starts with Battery Check
caption: Saskatoon winters don't mess around. One of the most common callouts we get is a dead battery on a -30°C morning. Your battery works hardest when it's cold, and most batteries over 3 years old are candidates for trouble. A quick battery test takes minutes and could save you from a freezing morning waiting for a tow. We come to you for these checks – no need to drive to a shop if your battery's already weak. Prevention beats roadside rescue every time.
image_prompt: A mechanic testing a car battery with a digital multimeter in a Saskatoon winter setting, frosty garage bay visible, professional photo

title: When Your Check Engine Light Comes On
caption: POV: It's -25°C, you're late for work, and your check engine light just turned on 💡😅 Nobody's got time for that nonsense. That's exactly why we exist – we come to your driveway, office parking lot, or wherever your Saskatoon life has you stuck. Your car gets diagnosed while you drink your coffee. No shop wait, no tow truck drama.

caption: When something goes wrong with your vehicle, you want someone trustworthy showing up.
